text:
Riley S.: hi @people-ops — back from parental leave but still recovering from delivery and dealing with severe back pain + feeding schedule. i want to request a temporary accommodation: reduced nights oncall for 8 weeks, flexible start times (between 9:30-11:00am), and access to the lactation room with a reserved slot after meeting-heavy mornings. also wondering about pump reimbursement.
Dana (Manager): Riley, thanks for sharing and welcome back. your health comes first — we can reassign nights and adjust start times. i’ll propose a plan and cc People Ops to document.
Carla (People Ops): hi Riley — thanks for letting us know. please submit a brief note via the confidential accommodations form or DM me the details. we can open a case and arrange interim coverage and equipment. you can redact clinical specifics; we only need functional limitations (e.g., "cannot handle overnight oncall", "needs 30–45min pumping slot mid-morning").
peopleops-bot: Case created: AC-2035-512 by Carla (People Ops). Status: intake.
Benefits: hi @Riley — lactation pump reimbursement is available under Benefits policy up to $250. we can also provide a hospital-grade pump via our vendor if medically necessary; please let us know what you'd prefer.
Riley S.: thanks. i'll upload the form now. preference: vendor order for a quiet pump and reserved lactation room bookings while breastfeeding. also would like the oncall nights reassigned for 8 weeks and then reviewed.
Dana (Manager): team: i can take 2 of Riley's oncall nights for weeks 1–4, and Priya offered to cover weeks 5–8. i'll update rota and send invites. Riley, we'll mark this as temporary accommodation (8-week review).
Carla (People Ops): next steps summary:
```
1) Riley submits confidential form or DMs Carla
2) People Ops opens AC-2035-512 and notifies Manager, Benefits, Facilities
3) Manager updates oncall rota and documents coverage plan (timeboxed: 8 weeks)
4) Benefits arranges pump reimbursement or vendor order (target: 5 business days)
5) Facilities reserves lactation room slots and posts quiet-room policy
6) People Ops schedules a 30-day check-in and a final 8-week review
```
Riley S.: uploaded a short functional note and DM'd Carla the confirmation. thanks everyone for the quick help.
Carla (People Ops): received. Benefits will start vendor order process. Facilities, please reserve two 30–45min lactation room slots between 10:00–12:00 daily for Riley for the next 8 weeks.
Facilities: noted. reserving two slots and setting "Lactation Room — RESERVED" on the booking board for Riley.
Legal Counsel: quick note — document accommodations factually and avoid linking to performance actions. if performance reviews are due during this period, adjust timelines or note accommodations in the review context.
Dana (Manager): understood. i will pause any performance escalation and adjust sprint commitments accordingly. will add note to the private manager doc and coordinate with People Ops.
peopleops-bot: AC-2035-512 status changed: intake -> documented.
Riley S.: truly appreciate the support. feeling much less anxious already. :heart:
Carla (People Ops): glad to help. we'll follow up in 30 days and before the 8-week review. if anything changes expedite via DM. all health info here is confidential. :lock:
Riley S.: thanks again. will keep you posted.
